risk_statement: Legacy PLC incompatibility may delay controls integration
trigger: Prototype communication fails or unsupported protocol identified
response: Prototype interface early and retain gateway fallback

risk_statement: VFD lead time may delay the critical procurement path
trigger: Supplier forecast exceeds baseline delivery date
response: Early procurement plus qualified equivalent-drive contingency

risk_statement: Required shutdown window may become unavailable
response: Coordinate outage at G2/G3 and maintain resequencing plan

risk_statement: Sensor data quality may be insufficient for acceptance evidence
trigger: Calibration failure or data completeness below threshold

risk_statement: COP target may not be achieved after initial tuning
response: Control retuning and root-cause analysis before acceptance
